# Temporary vendored Virtual Loot compatibility artifact

`virtualloot-0.3-lucid-cobblemon1.8-test3-patched.jar` contains the adapted MIT-licensed Virtual Loot classes/assets that are embedded in the current LucidMon binary.

It is retained temporarily so this repository can reconstruct the current integrated baseline while the patched implementation is migrated into LucidMon's normal source tree.

Upstream: Cobblemon: Virtual Loot by LunazStudios  
License: MIT  
See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

Do not install this vendor JAR separately on a server. It is a build input only.
